Ormuz mantiene un tránsito muy restringido en la última evaluación

HORMUZ DAILY — 2026-11-02

Hormuz transit remains severely restricted in the latest assessment

Lloyd's List reported on November 2, 2026, that the Premier Alliance adds more Suez services as Red Sea return accelerates, and that oil from a significant spill washes up on United Arab Emirates beaches.
